name: mcp-server-compute
title: MCP Server (Compute)
description: Add a user-scoped MCP server to your product, running on Supabase Compute.
docs: Set `[compute.mcp-server]` in `supabase/config.toml`, then deploy with `supabase compute push`. Set `SUPABASE_URL` and `SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` as secrets: a Compute instance is not given them automatically. A trusted product backend can call it with the signed-in user's access token. For external clients, install the [OAuth Consent block](https://supabase.com/library/docs/nextjs/oauth-consent), enable OAuth and dynamic registration, and set the Auth Site URL to the consent app. Every call runs through the user's RLS-scoped client. OAuth tokens include `client_id`; product sessions do not, so define policies for both paths. See [MCP authentication](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/auth/oauth-server/mcp-authentication) and [token security](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/auth/oauth-server/token-security).
